```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import json
import os
import re

data_path = os.environ["KIT_RENDER_DATA"]
with open(data_path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    payload = json.load(f)

print(f"# {payload['release']}\n")

for section in payload["sections"]:
    print(f"### {section['label']}\n")
    body = section["body"].strip()
    # The LLM sometimes wraps its whole answer in a fenced code block (e.g.
    # ```markdown ... ```), which would otherwise render as a literal code
    # block instead of formatted text.
    body = re.sub(r"^```[a-zA-Z]*\n(.*)\n```$", r"\1", body, flags=re.DOTALL).strip()
    # The LLM's own output often opens with its own H1 (e.g. "# Marketing
    # Promotion Kit"), which would just repeat the section label above it.
    body = re.sub(r"^#\s+.+?\n+", "", body, count=1)
    # Demote the LLM's own subheads (## Elevator Pitch, etc.) one level so
    # they stay visually smaller than the ### section label above them.
    body = re.sub(r"^##(?!#)", "####", body, flags=re.MULTILINE)
    body = body.replace("\n", "  \n")
    print(f"{body}\n")
```
